notes.title: Patch Version 1.02
notes.content:
Patch version 1.02

Constructible objects in the Town Hall no longer refresh each morning.
Barricade tier 3 can now properly be stalled and repaired when broken.
Barricade mini-games now properly inform you when lacking resources, as well as when no further upgrades are available.
The Warehouse area no longer features a hovering police car and a hovering bus.
Added a missing sound of shattering glass in the Gas station.
Clearing the blocked entrance in the Gas station no longer causes the cursor to disappear and bug out controls when looting/interacting.
Fixed an issue where some important objects had a (very) rare chance to not spawn.
Fixed multiple objects in the world that were appearing inside out.
The breaking sound of Graves now plays at the proper location.
Acid found on the ground can now be collected into an Empty Bottle as intended.
Fixed a situation where the Bottle of Water was not being locked by achievements as it should.
Adjusted the Exhausted stamina regeneration to be smoother as well as how it interacts with sprinting and vaulting.
Vaulting can no longer teleport you back to your starting position.
The text chat is now disabled during mini-games.
Added and adjusted some text notifications for consumable effects.
The advancements info now properly displays for upgrades.
The achievement tooltips on the achievement-board have been updated to be more accurate.
The day counter no longer displays the days you've survived but instead the current day.
Changed appearances of texts in-game to make them more clear and more consistent.
Updated the UI to be clearer while lockpicking.
Updated info on the controls on the inventory bag flap.
The Flashlight toggle now works as intended, many thanks for the report!

notes.title: Last Farewell Launch
notes.content:
[h1]Start of Last Farewell[/h1]
Three years ago we started on this project. We were completely new to game development.
We have had many struggles during these past three years and learned a lot from this project.
We know we've done some things correctly, but we now know of even more things to not repeat.

We want to thank you guys for being with us during this period and hopefully in the future.
Your feedback, suggestions, and interactions have motivated us to reach this day!

[h1]What is last farewell?[/h1]
Last Farewell is a single or multiplayer survival game with a hint of rogue-like.
The goal of the game is to find and beat the boss to obtain a truck later used to escape the city.
The truck first needs to be upgraded with some protection, and you need to make sure you are well stocked for the trip.

[h3]Townhall[/h3]
This is the Townhall! Here you will have places to craft and store items.
The Townhall is the only safe place during the night! Make sure to protect it at all costs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/db4d9c2c1d3ae9c0f9feadaeed779cf6ea298975.gif[/img]

[h3]Puppets[/h3]
There are 3 types of puppets
You have the Regular Puppets.
They focus on melee and swarming the player.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/345bf48e7323beaf6de73e6bf0af5a56460fd7ba.gif[/img]

You have the Sniper Puppet
They focus on ranged attacks and have a burst ability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/5d3180d0b74e2cd24f9eed9bb3657815da2b8b4f.gif[/img]
 
AND FINALLY THE BOSS
Big, Strong and unique in the world!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/ed0c614351009b58215159a478bea32cfe3b2484.gif[/img]

[h3]Looting[/h3]
During the day you will have to scavenge to find items for upgrading and barricading the Townhall!
Last Farewell has over 70 items, many of which are craftable and consumables to aid you in your struggles.
As you play you will get access to more and more of these.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/5e8b754066ff6b43764865614b6b3f3be4a6e6a8.gif[/img]

[h3]Progression[/h3]
There are many achievements that dictate your progression in-game. What you've managed to achieve will have
a positive impact on future games. Of course, you will have the option to completely reset your progress and
start over!

[h3]Blocks[/h3]
These are the various areas that make up your world based on your seed. They offer different loot and 
learning where you can find what can be very rewarding!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/a729e7f2de8d7e03c7ef6035b87190dd08f85c7f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/51b060e70fba4598e4155c27c8485b22ae801ab4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/7f6dd8b95ca5d4974b8ebb26e1b570be1b817653.png[/img]

[h3]Night[/h3]
At night puppets will start invading the Townhall through barricades. Prevent them from entering and killing you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/db4d9c2c1d3ae9c0f9feadaeed779cf6ea298975.gif[/img]

[h3]Farewell[/h3]
Finally, thank you for reading and we hope you enjoy this game and that we see you in the game discord. Farewell!

notes.title: Patch 0.4.2
notes.content:
[h1]Tutorial![/h1]
We added a tutorial!

You currently have 5 chapters that will teach you the basics of the game.
You will be taught how to survive the first couple of nights. 
After completing the tutorial you will receive a boost for the main game, so grab it while you are at it!

[h1]New puppet[/h1]
We've added a brand new model with different clothing variants. As well as a big bag of mo-capped and hand-made animations for them, to give more variety to enemies you'll be encountering during your runs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/10b8ea082d862f58a178f93c345b933fcec95331.png[/img]

[h1]New blocks and rotation[/h1]
[b]Rotations[/b]
The same block is now rotated in 4 different ways, adding a new feeling to them.

[b]Construction block[/b]
This is a new block where you can find very important item related to upgrading the workbench.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/09c929f673279fe1009c87fb9bad457c1f01f18c.png[/img]

[h1]Respawning[/h1]
At the beginning of the morning, players will now respawn after they've died, and at least 1 player is alive!
[h1]New attack animation[/h1]
The player has new animations for attacks!
The attack animations have been altered to be more accurate and now fluently chain into one another, when you attack multiple times.

[h1]Puppet Headshots[/h1]
Hitting a puppet on the head will deal more damage now.
Damage varies based on what weapon you use.

[h1]Disabled pickpocketing[/h1]
Due to inventory problem, we removed pickpocketing
Pickpocketing was part of the old game plan. But as the game has switched its direction, we don't have a reason to keep it anymore(especially with all the bugs it caused). 

[h1]Loot update[/h1]
We changed how loot spawns and balanced the amounts a bit. (Hopefully, you won't have 4 machetes in a fridge now)

Loot will spawn less around the town hall and more abundant the further away you go

[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
Optimized hiding of objects that arent visible.
Increased network and processing performance by altering how and when entities send data.

[h1]Rock throw indicator[/h1]
Now when throwing a rock you will have an icon in the bottom right corner that indicates when you can throw a rock again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/d9fb872dac88c6b93d3c8b4db2120feecdcfd4e6.png[/img]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
Sound playing in every player's ear.
Townhall markers are now only visible in townhall again.
You can no longer walk during the lockpicking mini-game.
Fixed items floating in the world.
Altered a couple of Typos.
Changed the compass to no longer say SE twice.
Fixed several bugs with the inventory.

[h1]Misc[/h1]
Reduced volume of the tent.
Player markers on the compass are no longer the same color.
It will now become lighter when you need to kill all puppets at night.
Tweaked vaulting insides some buildings (No longer vaulting over a coffee cup).
Improved AI movement and player detection.

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
[b]Color picking[/b]
We will add so before the match starts players can pick the color they want.
This color will be represented on the gloves, shirt, compass marker, landmarks, and sprays.

[b]Mini-games[/b]
Planning on adding small mini-games similar to lockpicking for repairing/upgrading wall hole covers.

[b]New enemies[/b]
We are working on 2 more enemy types.
These will need a different approach to killing them,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/985c60cf204837af333874e9dcab341d95c58942.png[/img]

[b]New townhall upgrades[/b]
More permanent upgrades for the town hall such as Welder & Crates!

notes.title: environment update 0.4.0
notes.content:
[h1]New world[/h1]
Fog has received some changes and it now both looks and performs better.

[u][b]New buildings[/b][/u]

[b]Gas station[/b]
The Gas station is a very reliable source for the new resource Gasoline and there might be more to it than that...🤔
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/e05b2091e82e46993bf8464857075884bcf47bbf.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/7ae6285d49e05efcaf6588f7fcfec9c17eca90d4.gif[/img]

[b]Gunstore[/b]
The Gunstore can spawn a firearm if you have unlocked the required achievements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/aed0ee166a6d2bd75d294397bc15f78565dfa0cb.gif[/img]

[u][b]New areas[/b][/u]

[b]Rescue Camp[/b]
The Rescue Camp may contain the Axe which is important for the new Woodcutting mechanic.

[b]Other areas[/b]
We’ve filled out the world with new areas that can spawn which should spice up the variation you find in the world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/0f815fdd44c24cfc02cc45602c8de5dbbde6cf61.gif[/img]

[u][b]Vehicles[/b][/u]

[b]Police car[/b]
The Police car has the same functionality as a car but in addition may allow you to find a firearm if you have unlocked the required achievements.

[b]Taxi[/b]
The Taxi has the functionality of a car and adds some flair to the world.

[b]Bus[/b]
The Bus was added to enhance the world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/1abc21a7edd8cba8290e6a90558b66cd846d1acb.gif[/img]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
We added a new way to see achievements and track your progression.
Now you will be able to see what achievement you need in order to get new items.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/133f5d5275e419acac63c7fe29ad813e27cef859.png[/img]

[b]What's On The Menu?[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/0c2f43d6d10313fb94c00777bd8b0a5dd2eeb9bf.png[/img]
[i]Eat 50 Food Items[/i]
[i]Ability to construct campfire[/i]

[b]Cozy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/6de42c9fd9eb66d3e1cc2f97c08a3364348a62ea.png[/img]
[i]Construct The Campfire[/i]
[i]Campfire at start of the game and cooking[/i]

[b]Roasted[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/39c09b989f3b53da611d5f8b078ea558cf3bdd4c.png[/img]
[i]Construct Campfire Tier 2[/i]
[i]Extra cooking spot[/i]

[b]Toasted[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/eb321db8e2c90007d0cb5bd594060b66892ea08f.png[/img]
[i]Construct Campfire Tier 3[/i]
[i]Extra cooking spot[/i]

[b]Timber[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/8e26b20473aa53f00520ef62c7f1476ebba3aede.png[/img]
[i]Find the axe[/i]
[i]Unlocks makeshift recipe[/i]

[h1]Vaulting and sprint rework[/h1]
Vaulting is separated from jumping and instead automatically triggers while sprinting.
Sprint duration is now limited.

[h1]Status effects rework[/h1]
[b]Drugged[/b]
Increases movement speed but reduces max health. This effect lasts a full day, if using items that give the Drugged effect while already drugged there’s a chance to become Addicted.

[b]Addicted[/b]
Addiction stacks, giving an increasing risk of not retaining the food you consume as well as decreases your max health.
It stacks to 3, increases each morning and stacks are reduced by consuming drugs.
To clear addiction you need to go 2 full days without consuming drugs.

[b]Wounded[/b]
If you take 30 or more damage at once or are below 30 health, you become Wounded or gain a wounded stack.
Wounded stacks to 3 and each morning adds a stack.
While wounded, your movement speed is lowered. 
Taking damage while wounded may cause infection based on your current stacks.
Some items can remove Wounded.

[b]Infected[/b]
You have a chance to become Infected if attacked while being Wounded or by eating certain consumables.
Infection progresses from 1% up to 100% and if you reach 100% you will die.
If you were to gain Infection while already Infected, you instead gain a stack.
Every morning each stack of infection increases the progression of the infection.
You can have up to 3 stacks of infection
Antibiotics will remove a stack of infected, clear all stacks to remove the effect.

[h1]Bottles and puddles[/h1]

All puddles can be collected with an empty bottle resulting in a bottle containing the resource.
You may throw these bottles to create puddles, different bottles and puddles have different uses.

[i]Empty bottle[/i]
Used to collect the puddles into a bottle.

[i]Puddle of Water / Bottle of Water[/i]
Consumable, extra water source.

[i]Puddle of Acid / Bottle of Acid[/i]
A crafting ingredient in bottle form, the puddle slows and damages.

[i]Puddle of Alcohol / Bottle of Alcohol[/i]
Can be consumed to gain Drugged and is a crafting ingredient in bottle form, can be lit on fire creating an area of flames the size of a Molotov fire.

[i]Puddle of Gasoline / Bottle of Gasoline[/i]
A crafting ingredient in bottle form, can be lit on fire creating an area of flames the size of a Molotov+ fire.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/406b45c8e27096e7d7affb03f9bcc9576bb05143.gif[/img]

[h1]New items[/h1]
Can of Beans - Food
Can of Cooked Beans - Food
Empty Can - Resource
Makeshift grenade - Ranged explosive weapon
Electric grenade - Ranged explosive and electric weapon
Acid grenade - Ranged explosive and acidic weapon
Makeshift mine - Explosive trap
Makeshift mine fire - Explosive fire trap
Makeshift mine acid - Explosive acid trap
Makeshift mine electric - Explosive electric trap
Molotov - Ranged fire weapon
Molotov+ - Ranged fire weapon
Toolbox - Resource, enables crafting bench recipes on the road
Spark plug - Resource
Axe - Stick harvesting tool and weapon
Makeshift axe - Stick harvesting tool and weapon
Copper cable - Resource

[h1]Ui changes[/h1]
Added new Inventory UI
The improved crafting recipe book to contain tabs and images.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/db7f46c5e202f546cdaa579eb8fabe1a7d5c96b1.gif[/img]

[h1]New gate[/h1]
Added a new gate to the town hall that will slide open.
You no longer have to open and close 2 doors, instead you will have 1 object to interact with.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/06c99b064cb912c94cf07d5b05726b86a1d60245.gif[/img]

[h1]Minor tweaks[/h1]
Tents when jumped on now leave behind a broken version
Added players on the Compass
Added a single player button
Added new aim down sight animations for the gun
Added an additional hotbar slot
Adjusted puppet drops to include most items
The Park is temporarily taken out of the game for re-design
Performance enhancements
Altered costs for hole cover repairs and upgrades
Altered some item stacking limits

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Fixed puppets not able to walk upstairs in the Town hall
Puppets spawn less in line of sight of the player
Fixed inventory crashes
Fixed player being stuck in an animation
Players can block with weapons again
Fixed not able to hit downwards (this was a client side issue only)
Puppets attack at night again
Fixed wall holes cover network issues
Fixed some door network issues
Glass breaking has been made more consistent
Improved fit hit traces
Stick, Stick with Nails, Stick with Barbedwire, Torch, hit detection improvements

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
[b]Color picking[/b]
We will add so before the match starts players can pick the color they want.
This color will be represented on the gloves, shirt, compass marker, landmarks, and sprays.

[b]Tutorial[/b]
We plan on making a tutorial for basics such as
[list]
[*]Interacting
[*]Looting
[*]Fighting
[*]Ect.
[/list]

[b]New enemies[/b]
We are working on 2 more enemy types.
These will need a different approach to killing them,
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/985c60cf204837af333874e9dcab341d95c58942.png[/img]

[b]New townhall upgrades[/b]
More permanent upgrades for the town hall such as Welder & Crates!

[b]MORE ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.4
notes.content:
[h1]Hey hey![/h1]
The stream of fixes and tweaks continues! Keep reading to see what's been fixed and added.

[h1]Highlights[/h1]

[b]Single-player button[/b]
We've seen that some players have been confused about how to play the game on their own, so we went ahead and added a more straightforward and convenient way of launching a single-player game. 

[b]Minor changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The music in the Town Hall fades off at night.
[*] The Molotov now plays a sound effect when shattering.
[*] The Molotov damage has been updated from 15 to 20 damage per second.
[*] The Molotov visuals have gotten an improvement, but more changes are coming.
[*] The Salvaging box does no longer accepts items that cannot be salvaged.
[*] Loot balance updates you will now find more Bolts and Nails and fewer Machetes, among other changes.
[*] Fall damage adjusted.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Player first-person shadows will now function as they were intended to.
[*] Cooking a Potato will now yield a Baked Potato.
[*] The Town Hall gate doors will close as the night-phase starts and cannot be opened during that time.
[*] Copper wire inventory spacing will now match the icon.
[/list]

We want to invite you to try our new patch before it goes live.
To get access to the test patch follow these instructions.

1) Right click on the game and go to properties

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/89c918339a6891bf4867eeebb5bc72595c3071c9.png[/img]

2) Click on betas
3) Now select the PatchBuild
4) Update the game and done!

If you run into any issues contact us on our discord or Twitter!
[b]Discord code:[/b] KY6kNa4
[b]Twitter:[/b] @LastFarewellFTS

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/0bb10eb0f9645f64528bdcea8f977461db9ca06d.png[/img]

[h1]Content[/h1]
In this update, we focused on the more combat-related features.
We added more items, achievements, new UI elements, and altered puppet behavior.
Added multiple new mechanics.


[h1]Achievment unlockables[/h1]

[b]Crafting table upgrades[/b]
You now start the game without a crafting table. You now first need to build it in order to use it.
Once you have built it you will unlock the achievement [b]Crafting beginner[/b] allowing you to keep this progression.

[b]First Tier[/b]
This crafting table enables advanced crafting recipes.

[b]Second Tier[/b]
The second tier allows you to use a brand new mechanic called Salvaging.
Salvaging lets you to break down items for some basic components.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/6059e123b6cde6996368d64289fe8fd8b6edef0c.png[/img]

[b]Light spots[/b]

The light spot requires a car battery to run every game you play but when the light spot is constructed you will not lose it in your next game.

[h1]Ui elements[/h1]
We added a new inventory UI that looks more consistent with each other.

The crafting book got a complete overhaul making it more interactive

Puppets now have an indicator displaying the puppets' awareness of your presence! A question mark will fill up as you draw attention causing them to eventually investigate what they are noticing. An exclamation mark signifies that it might be time for you to run, or fight if you so choose!

Greetings from Flat Tail Studios
Help us make the game great!

notes.title: The Big Christmas Feast Update!
notes.content:
[u][b][h1]MERRY X-MAS Survivors[/h1][/b][/u]
Hey Hey Survivors
Here is our first UPDATE!
We have been working on a lot of things and from those things, a lot of ideas came as well for future updates. We hope to be fixing up a lot of stuff in 2021, So please give us your feedback on Discord or Twitter and let us know what you would like to see.

[h1]Achievements![/h1]
[b]The Future of achievements[/b]
In the future, we plan to add more achievements with roguelike elements to them.
You unlock more items the more challenges you complete.
Items you can unlock will be recipes, items, and even permanent upgrades for the Town Hall!

[u][b]First Achievements[/b][/u]
[b]Schrödinger[/b]
[img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/50705779297_864078a9bb_m.jpg[/img]
[i]Find Schrödinger in the world[/i]
[i]Unlocks ??? [/i]

[b]Beaver Burger[/b]
[img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/50705697006_35d2a0a539_m.jpg[/img]
[i]Eat 5 steaks and 5 pieces of bread.[/i]
[i]Unlocks the Beaver Burger recipe and world spawns.[/i] 

[b]Nailed It![/b]
[img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/50704958408_fc759bb8dd_m.jpg[/img]
[i]Kill 10 puppets with a plank in one game.[/i]
[i]Unlocks the Plank with Nails recipe and world spawns.[/i]

[b]Whack To The Past[/b]
[img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/50705696946_fa10c9d16c_m.jpg[/img]
[i]Kill 10 puppets with a log in one game.[/i]
[i]Unlocks the Stick with Nails recipe and world spawns.[/i]

[b]Getting Desperate?[/b]
[img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/50704958428_6af93ef0de_m.jpg[/img]
[i]Eat nothing for 7 days in a row in 1 game.[/i]
[i]Unlocks the Mystery Meat world spawns.[/i]

[b]Survived 1 day[/b]
[img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/50705696891_0ff9a6bf72_m.jpg[/img]
[i]Survive 1 day in one game.[/i]

[b]Survived 5 days[/b]
[img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/50704958303_bd2193f452_m.jpg[/img]
[i]Survive 5 days in one game.[/i]

[b]Survived 10 days[/b]
[img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/50705696856_f1035cf550_m.jpg[/img]
[i]Survive 10 days in one game.[/i]

[b]Running Low[/b]
[img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/50704958368_a0740ba42f_m.jpg[/img]
[i]Empty the water well.[/i]
[i]Unlocks the Water bottle world spawns.[/i]

[h1]Food[/h1]
[b]Hunger system[/b]
When you survive a night you will get a hunger counter.
This counter will reduce your maximum health by 10.
[u]The hunger counters can stack and end up killing you![/u]

[b]Campfire[/b]
The Campfire is a new utility in the town hall.
To light up the campfire you will need 2 sticks and 1 box of matches.
The campfire will remain lit throughout the entire day and night.
After night passes the fire will go out.

[b]Cooking[/b]
With the updated hunger mechanics we've also revisited how you can fill that need. 
Some foods can now be cooked into improved versions providing more benefits.
To cook food, the campfire needs to be lit up.
Then you can interact with the cooking equipment to cook the food on there. 
Your cooking equipment can be upgraded using scavenged materials.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/7aea28c2417b0d97c49cad0f551176f61524555e.gif[/img]

[u][b]Food items[/b][/u]
Food items can have any of these 4 buffs now:

[b]Health Buff[/b]
[list]
[*] It can increase your maximum health for the rest of the day with X amount.
[*] It can heal you over time.
[/list]
[i]Consuming a food with a better buff will replace your current one.[/i]

[b]Stamina[/b]
[list]
[*] It can increase your maximum Stamina for the rest of the day with X amount.
[*] It can provide increased stamina regeneration for the rest of the day.
[/list]
[i]Consuming a food with a better buff will replace your current one.[/i]

[b]Item stat changes[/b]
[b][*]Raw meat (New)[/b]
[i]Heals 15 health over 15 seconds.
Increases max health by 15 for the rest of the day.
Removes 1 hunger counter.
Moderate chance of getting infected.[/i]

[b][*]Potato (New)[/b]
[i]Heals 5 health over 5 seconds.
Cook for 20 seconds to turn into Baked Potato
Removes 1 hunger counter.[/i]

[b][*]Baked potato (New)[/b]
[i]Heals 20 health over 20 seconds.
Increases max health by 20 for the rest of the day.
Removes 1 hunger counter.[/i]

[b][*]Cooked mystery meat (New)[/b]
[i]Heals 30 health over 15 seconds.
Increases max health by 30 for the rest of the day.
Removes 1 hunger counter.[/i]

[b][*]Crisps (New)[/b]
[i]Heals 50 health over 50 seconds.
Increases max health by 50 for the rest of the day.
Removes 1 hunger counter.[/i]

[b][*]Muffin cake (New)[/b]
[i]Heals 20 health over 10 seconds.
Increases max health by 20 for the rest of the day.
Removes 1 hunger counter.[/i]

[b][*]Beaver Burger (New)[/b]
[i]Heals 50 health over 25 seconds.
Increases max health by 50 for the rest of the day.
Removes 1 hunger counter.[/i]
[i]Can be crafted with 1 bread and 1 cooked steak after getting the achievement ''Beaver Burger''.[/i]

[b][*]Bar of chocolate (New)[/b]
[i]Heals 20 health over 10 seconds.
Increases max health by 20 for the rest of the day.
Removes 1 hunger counter.[/i]

[b][*]Instant Noodles[/b]
[i]Heals 10 health over 5 seconds.
Increases max health by 10 for the rest of the day.
Removes 1 hunger counter.[/i]

[b][*]Bread (New)[/b]
[i]Heals 10 health over 10 seconds.
Removes 1 hunger counter.[/i]

[b][*]Steak[/b]
[i]Heals 35 health over 17.5 seconds.
Increases max health by 35 for the rest of the day.
Removes 1 hunger counter.[/i]

[b][*]Mystery Meat[/b]
[i]Heals 25 health over 12.5 seconds.
Increases max health by 25 for the rest of the day.
Removes 1 hunger counter.
Moderate chance of getting infected.[/i]

[b][*]Energy Drink[/b]
[i]Removes dehydrated and thirsty.
Gives a speed buff for the rest of the day.
Increases stamina regeneration by 5 for the rest of the day.
Increases maximum stamina by 15 for the rest of the day.[/i]

[b][*]Soda (New)[/b]
[i]Removes dehydrated and thirsty.
Increases stamina regeneration by 15 for the rest of the day.[/i]

[b][*]Coffee[/b]
[i]Gives a speed buff for the rest of the day.
Increases stamina regeneration by 20 for the rest of the day.
Increases maximum stamina by 35 for the rest of the day.[/i]

[b][*]Bottle of Water[/b]
Removes dehydrated and thirsty.
Can be used 2 times.

[h1]Character updates[/h1] 
[i]
[*]Fist damage reduced.
[i]Attack Stamina Cost: from -15 to -10[/i]
[*]No Stamina Attack Delay Multiplier: from x4 to x2.5

[*]Block Stamina Cost: from -20 to -10

[*]Base Line Stamina Regen: from 20/s to 10/s
[/i]

[h1]World updates[/h1]
[b]Vending machines[/b]
The vending machine has a more visible indication it hasn't been punched yet.

[b]Town hall re-design[/b]
[i]The Town Hall has been re-designed for an improved look.[/i]

[b]Indicators[/b]
Added highlights to the items and loot containers.
Added ghost-objects to mark available constructions.
Updated indicator icons for important locations in the Town hall.

[b]New loot distribution [/b]
We have altered where loot spawns and added the new items to the loot containers.

[b]New interior versions[/b]
We have made a new interior for several houses and added them into the world.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/5442062cba76340de41d9fdc99b56bd13587f17c.gif[/img]

[h1]Item Updates[/h1]

Added [b]Box of matches (New)[/b]
[i]This item will be used to light up the campfire![/i]

Added [b]Pieces of cloth (New)[/b]
[i]This item will be used to craft bandages. [/i]

Added [b]Barbed wire (New)[/b]
[i]Will slow enemies slightly when entering.[/i]
[i]Will do 5 damage upon entering[/i]

Added [b]Plank with barbed wire (New)[/b]
[i]Base damage of 50[/i]

Added [b]Stick with barbed wire (New)[/b]
[i]Base damage of 34[/i]

Added [b]Bear trap[/b]
[i]Will stun the enemy for 1.5 seconds.[/i]
[i]Deals 50 damage when trapped.[/i]

Added [b]Torch (New)[/b]
[i]Weapons that will burn any enemy hurt by it.[/i]
[i]Base damage of 25[/i]
[i]Damage overtime 25 over 5 sec[/i]
[i]Durability reduces each second when lit.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/b00ff8316693b86081e83e2b6b2810b020b9af12.gif[/img]

[h1]Durability[/h1]
[i]Items now have durability, meaning that over time they wear down from use and will disappear.
The durability of an item has no impact on crafting or construction, so make sure your items don't break![/i]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bear Trap bug fixes.
[*] Animation bug fixes.
[*] The weapon hit detection bug fixes.
[*] Water well ration calculation fixes.
[*] Thirst icon bug fix.
[/list]

[h1]In The Future[/h1]
We plan to work on bug fixing right after this update.
Furthermore, in the next update we want to focus more on combat-orientated features.
[list]
[*] Working on how the enemies behave.
[*] Getting more weapons in!
[*] Work on animations to make the combat not feel repetitive.
[*] Adding more achievements that will unlock items in your runs
[*] MORE PERMANENT UPGRADES!
[/list]

[u][b]Have a nice X-MAS and A HAPPY NEW YEAR
from everyone at Flat Tails Studios[/b][/u]

notes.title: Patch notes November 20, 2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/96df99d53b8b5c3f0e2d0ce6a3d20f68fecb81c3.png[/img][h1]Hey hey Survivors![/h1]

While we are working on the big update for December we have added fixes that according to feedback and testing improves the stability of the game a great deal! The Townhall is currently under re-construction and we have a spray mechanic and a vending machine change that we'd love to hear your thoughts on!


[h1]Character updates[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added spray functionality 
[i]Currently lacking a custom bind option, the default key is M[/i]
[/list]
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/510860929768882283/779359586238332928/SprayUse.png?width=1204&height=677[/img]
[h1]World updates[/h1]

[list]
[*] Vending machines can now be hit and has a chance of providing you with Energy Drinks.
[*] Townhall is under reconstruction, multiple changes are in the making.
[/list]
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/510860929768882283/779359587882238002/VendingUse.png?width=1204&height=677[/img]

[h1]Misc.[/h1]

[list]
[*] Notifies the clients when kicked from the session because host leaving.
[*] The car trunk is now the interactable part of the car instead of the whole car.
[/list]


[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Crafting an item now removes materials when dragging from the crafting output box.
[*] Dragging items from the crafting mat no longer hides materials on it.
[*] Crafting with Random Pills will only produce other Pills.
[*] Spectator cursor is visible when moved to the "End game"-screen.
[*] Spectating now has the correct HUD displaying the name of the person being spectated.
[*] Screenshot-mode now hides the Townhall markers properly and will show the inventory.
[*] Packages dropped by Puppets no longer disappear when picking them up with a full inventory.
[*] Items in your inventory should no longer stuck when returning to the Townhall as a client.
[*] Holding down the mouse button outside of the inventory no longer hides the cursor.
[*] You can now quick loot from the Vault.
[/list]

[h1]On the horizon[/h1]

[i]The primary focus is and will remain a big update in December adding and updating content such as weapons, foods, crafting recipes, and several essential game mechanics that we have been planning. You can expect minor updates in between, but until then we hope you are able to enjoy the game as it is![/i]

- Flat Tail Studios

notes.title: Patch notes October 19, 2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37057308/2dea72dd435cf93abea05d641c1270eae9b7f65e.png[/img]

[i][h1]Hey Hey Survivors,[/h1] 
We’re here to bring you our first patch! First of all, thank you to everyone who has given their feedback on our game so far, We’ll try our best to polish out the issues you guys pointed out, as well as work our hardest to implement more features and gameplay elements to the game. But all in its due time, and on today’s menu, we mostly have light bug fixes we were able to solve during the weekend.[/i]

[h1]Character updates[/h1]

[list]
[*] Updated character backwards movement speed from 35% to 60% of walk speed.
[/list]

[h1]Item updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Item despawn countdown increased from 30 to 45 seconds 
[i]From feedback, we’ve concluded the time was too low.[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Misc.[/h1]

[list]
[*] Minor network performance updates
[*] Minor building optimization updates

[*] Added: Option to toggle Friendly Fire in the host menu

[*] Removed: Custom lobby names
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] A crash from equipping items from a hot-bar slot at the very end of a consumption animation should be resolved.
[*] Keybindings should no longer reset in between games or during gameplay.
[*] Fixed broken animations on loot containers.
[*] Updated faulty image among the in-game tips.
[/list]

[h1]On the horizon[/h1]

At the moment our main focus is going to be resolving bugs and making the game run as smoothly as possible. For this reason, you can expect us to update the game quite frequently until it moves into a more stable state.

[i]Again, we deeply appreciate the time you've taken to send us your bug-reports and your feedback on Last Farewell. Keep Surviving and don't shy away from letting us know how we can make the game more enjoyable for you![/i]

-Flat Tail Studios
